_comment: Claim 15 (paper Fig. 5) at 1/10 of the data with the paper's ratios kept: the parametric softmax has as many trained keys as the GWS database holds after 50 epochs (paper: 2.56M keys for 50,000 images; here 249,664 keys for 5,000 images, about 50 per image), and it trains for 2,000 epochs against 50 for GWS. The full-scale parametric run needs about 126 GB for parameters, gradients and Adam state. Learning rates 3e-3 and 1e-2 are the low end of the paper's grid [3e-3, 1e-2, 3e-2, 1e-1] (optimizer not stated; Adam here); T = 1 is inside the paper's T grid. Plain softmax (equal fixed weights), as the paper reports for this baseline. Train accuracy on the first 2,000 non-augmented training images, test accuracy on the first 2,000 test images (final: all 10,000).
